name: andrej-karpathy-skills

business_use_cases: A dev team copies it into their repo to get more disciplined AI-assisted coding without paying for anything.
A coding-agent vendor studies which guideline patterns resonate to bake similar defaults into their own product.
A developer-education creator uses the same 'one file, big promise' format as a free lead magnet for their own paid content.

steal_this: Don't copy the file — copy the move: write your own narrow, well-named 'one file fixes X' guideline for your stack and use it to drive traffic to something you actually sell.
